holderQuote: “This is Bastion-General Zavarial. Opening a Tier 7 Scroll. Clear the area.”
effectQuote: An arrow? Yes and no. Was a pillar of ice, as tall as some of the titans on the battlefield, an arrow? It formed in the air, cold enough to feel like burning to those close enough to it. Hundreds of feet up—it began to rotate. The serpents began to scatter, leaving their titan-form.

holderQuote: The Goblin King burst out of the waters with a new spell appearing overhead
